name: Feature-Injection Image Captioning Benchmark
description: A benchmark to evaluate image captioning architectures that inject external features, comparing performance under standardized data splits and metrics.
evaluation_method: BLEU / CIDEr / METEOR (standard image-captioning metrics), typically CIDEr as primary
general_score_metric: CIDEr (common primary metric for image captioning)
reputation: A specialized benchmark focusing on architectures that inject external features; limited mainstream adoption compared to large captioning datasets like COCO.
notes: Dataset and evaluation targeted at a niche architectural question (feature injection); may be smaller or more specialized than general captioning corpora, so results may not transfer to broad captioning benchmarks.
